lme_vectors.rationale: This is a capped call confirmation (an equity derivative) between Lucid and a dealer. It has no lien, priority or sacred-rights provisions.
lme_vectors.basis: The document is an ISDA call option Confirmation tied to the 5.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030. It contains no secured debt terms or lender voting terms.

lme_vectors.rationale: The text has no restricted/unrestricted subsidiary framework and no limit on transferring assets or IP.
lme_vectors.basis: The provisions cover option exercise, the calculation agent, early conversion, repayment events, transfer of the options, and termination payments.

lme_vectors.rationale: The confirmation does not limit how much debt the Counterparty can incur.
lme_vectors.basis: The only reference to debt is the Convertible Notes issued under the Indenture: USD [1,000,000,000] plus an option for up to USD [100,000,000] more.

lme_vectors.rationale: The confirmation contains no restricted payments covenant or basket.
lme_vectors.basis: The provisions about payments cover only settlement and termination amounts between Dealer and Counterparty under the Transaction.
